howto.name: Enter a HEX color
howto.text: Type a HEX code (#FF5733, or the short #F53 form), or click the swatch to pick a color.

howto.name: PrivaTools shows the same color in every format
howto.text: Live conversion: HEX, RGB, RGBA, HSL, a Tailwind class and a CSS variable, plus a contrast rating against white or black text.

howto.name: Copy the value you need
howto.text: Use the Copy button on any row. Runs entirely in your browser — no network roundtrip.

faq.a: No. Input is a 3- or 6-digit HEX code without alpha, and the RGBA row always shows an alpha of 1.

faq.q: What does the contrast badge mean?
faq.a: It rates the color against white or black text, whichever contrasts more, with the WCAG formula: AAA at 7:1 or more, AA at 4.5:1, AA Large at 3:1, and Fail below that.
Yes — pure browser JavaScript. No network requests.
